$comment: The library's space and shape options (owner F12, 2026-11-07; brief O53-O55). System data, not a theme's choice: a theme picks one of each in space-shape.config.json. Each option re-maps the semantic roles only; the 4 px scale, sizes, targets and text never change. tools/space-shape.mjs writes the tokens and checks the invariants. Edit here, then run npm run tokens.

roles.stack-pair: Stacked pair that reads as one: label and field, title and subtitle
roles.stack-row: Between rows of a list whose rows carry their own fill (navigation items, menu items), so two fills never touch
roles.stack-group: Groups within a section; fields in a form
roles.inline-item: Items in one row: buttons in a group
roles.inline-group: Groups in a row: toolbar groups
roles.inset-xs: Inside a compact group, around each member’s fill: a segmented control
roles.inset-sm: Inside compact containers: menus, list rows
roles.inset-lg: Inside dialogs, sheets and page regions
roles.gutter: Between columns and regions of a layout
roles.margin-page: Content to window edge on small screens

compact.label: Compact
compact.for: Dense working screens people use all day: tables, dashboards, admin and developer tools, where seeing more at once matters more than breathing room.

normal.label: Normal
normal.for: The default for most products: forms, settings and content pages read comfortably without wasting room.

loose.label: Loose
loose.for: Calmer products people visit now and then: marketing pages, onboarding, consumer apps, where each screen asks for one thing at a time.

extra-loose.label: Extra loose
extra-loose.for: Editorial and showcase pages on large screens: portfolios, long reads and launches, where space itself sets the tone.

roles.sm: Small parts: badges’ marks, inline code, checkboxes, keys
roles.md: Controls and the things built like them: buttons, fields, menus, list items
roles.pill: Shapes drawn as pills by choice, not by nature: badges and the outer ends of a whole bar; square when the shape is sharp

sharp.label: Sharp
sharp.for: Precise, technical or editorial brands: data tools, finance, newspapers. Only shapes that are round by nature stay round (a switch, a dot, a spinner, an avatar).

rounded.label: Rounded
rounded.for: The default: friendly but businesslike, for most products.

soft.label: Soft
soft.for: Approachable consumer products: health, education, lifestyle, where the interface should feel gentle.

super-soft.label: Super soft
super-soft.for: Playful or very casual brands: games, kids, social apps. Controls become pills and surfaces get generous curves.
